chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Pasadena, 1994: the World Cup final. Brazil attack Italy. Romário slips the ball to Bebeto, on the left of the box. Paolo Maldini stays close… Bebeto crosses. Blocked!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Maldini doesn’t dive in. He stays on his feet, and waits. Bebeto crosses, and Maldini’s leg is right there.

chapters.label: Clean
chapters.text: The ball bounces off Maldini and out for a corner. No foul, no fall: just clean defending.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That’s Maldini. Wait for the right moment, stay on your feet, and win the ball cleanly. Don’t dive in!
